subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are given. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing ‘6’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb62032674e13ad9c0ec1dbf86732c4e06f1429a7fb2afb64ac84bc6a50a1200.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 4 is common on both the dice I and III, it is clear that 3, 2, 5, and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining number i.e., 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de41b320f43857e1bf0c68aae71d8501d5c8c70b877766f60f8a3275024059c8.png] 

Opposite pairs:

2 → 6

3 → 5

1 → 4

So, the opposite side of "2" will be side "6".

Hence, the correct answer is "2".
